Story/Task: As a founder, I want the site hidden until launch so public users see under construction only.
Acceptance Criteria: Unauthenticated users see construction page and cannot access studio routes.

Story/Task: Build cinematic dashboard shell with navigation and pipeline progress.
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard loads with pipeline stages and protected routes.

Story/Task: As a producer, I can upload or paste a script for validation.
Acceptance Criteria: Script text accepts paste/upload and validation results appear.

Story/Task: Generate logline, theme, emotional arc, characters, and locations.
Generate Save-the-Cat-style beat breakdown with scene ranges.
Acceptance Criteria: Each beat has summary, purpose, continuity notes, confidence, status.

Story/Task: Generate scene cards from approved beats.
Acceptance Criteria: Each scene has slugline, characters, location, runtime, purpose.

Story/Task: Generate shot list using cinematography rules.
Acceptance Criteria: Shot list includes lens, movement, 180 axis, continuity, emotion.

Story/Task: Generate storyboard panels from approved shots.
Acceptance Criteria: Panel cards show status, prompt, camera, emotion, revision notes.

Story/Task: Allow per-panel prompt edits and continuity locks.
Acceptance Criteria: Panel editor saves prompt/revision and approval state.

Story/Task: Create dynamic storyboard timeline from approved panels.
Acceptance Criteria: Timeline supports duration, motion, voice/music/SFX slots.

Story/Task: Export package for video generation providers.
Acceptance Criteria: JSON export includes script, beats, scenes, shots, panels, QA.
QA dashboard shows findings and recommendations.
